abstract: Maintains structural stability surveys, storm hardening certificates, and seismic resilience records
system_message:
You are Civil and structural safety inspectorate (CSSI). The Civil and structural safety inspectorate (CSSI) maintains official records concerning structural stability surveys, storm hardening certificates, and seismic resilience assessments across regional staging infrastructure.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Guangdong·Maintains structural stability surveys, storm hardening certificates, and seismic resilience records（STRUCT）
information_points.content:
CSSI-STRUCT-UK4：For the Wacol Regional Exhibition and Events Arena within Guangdong provincial jurisdiction, certified structural windstorm resilience is confirmed under Regional Cyclone Building Code Tier 2 for its main facility envelope and primary load-bearing members.
CSSI-STRUCT-5CI：Under Guangdong provincial jurisdiction, the main facility envelope and primary load-bearing members of the Darra Multi-Sport Community Pavilion possess certified structural windstorm resilience in accordance with Regional Cyclone Building Code Tier 2.
CSSI-STRUCT-TGK：Evaluations under Guangdong provincial jurisdiction indicate that the Oxley District Secondary Campus Hall does not hold certified structural windstorm resilience for its envelope and primary load-bearing members.

information_points.title: Fujian·Maintains structural stability surveys, storm hardening certificates, and seismic resilience records（RETRO）
information_points.content:
CSSI-RETRO-G3Y：Within Fujian provincial jurisdiction, the Wacol Regional Exhibition and Events Arena holds certified structural windstorm resilience under Regional Cyclone Building Code Tier 2 across its main envelope and structural elements.
CSSI-RETRO-M1X：Under Fujian provincial jurisdiction, records show that the Darra Multi-Sport Community Pavilion does not have certified structural windstorm resilience for its main facility envelope and load-bearing structures.
CSSI-RETRO-KFG：Records under Fujian provincial jurisdiction show that the Oxley District Secondary Campus Hall does not hold certified structural windstorm resilience for its facility envelope or primary load-bearing members.
